blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: assumption — Condition accepted within a model.
irrelevant — Detail that does not affect task.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Abstraction selects only the information required for the task and deliberately excludes irrelevant real-world detail.

blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: An abstract model is a simplification of reality: here distance and child/adult status determine the fare; hair colour does not.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: The model is only as good as its assumptions. If peak pricing or concessions apply, the abstraction needs refinement.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain
blocks.text: ParkingFee(hours)=hours×£2 for the simplified model; define non-negative hours and rounding rules.
